name: logo-wrapper
summary: Aspect-locked frame for a single brand logo so it scales without distortion. Figma: [Molecule / Logo Wrapper](https://www.figma.com/design/0o8SL5BEk8wHtgud00dRyg/Web-ODS-Shared-Library?node-id=3768-2718&m=dev) (`3768:2718`). Spec Frame [`3846:98`](https://www.figma.com/design/0o8SL5BEk8wHtgud00dRyg/Web-ODS-Shared-Library?node-id=3846-98&m=dev). Sticker board `3792:48`.

properties.name: src
properties.description: Brand logo URL; empty shows docs placeholder

properties.name: alt
properties.description: Brand name, or `""` when named nearby

accessibility: Render logo as a native `img` with descriptive `alt` naming the brand, or `alt=""` when the brand is already named nearby.
No custom roles; meaning is carried by `alt`.
Non-interactive — never in the tab order. If the logo links home, the wrapping link owns keyboard + focus.
Placeholder label is documentation-only and not shipped to users.
